dict.string: Vitail connects to the development server on your local network.

Vitail shows your position and records walks you start, including while locked or in the background. Routes stay on this device; samples are sent to validate walking points. Friend sharing and Net-Walking are off by default. If you enable them, a fresh position is briefly shared with allowed walkers only during an active walk. Pause or finish to stop.
Precise location is needed while you choose to verify a venue check-in.
Precise location validates walking distance and, only if you enable Friends or Net-Walking, briefly shares a fresh position with allowed walkers during an active walk.
